newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Jiang Zemin arrives for Hong Kong handover.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiang Zemin arrives for Hong Kong handover.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin stepped onto Hong Kong soil on Monday to receive the territory back from Britain after 156 years of colonial rule.
Jiang, the first Chinese head of state to visit Hong Kong, was greeted warmly by future leader Tung Chee-hwa, head of the civil service Anson Chan and China's Foreign Minister Qian Qichen.

Jiang, accompanied by other Chinese leaders including Premier Li Peng and Zhuo Lin, widow of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, arrived on an Air China Boeing 747 from the neighbouring Chinese boomtown of Shenzhen.
The official greeting party struggled with plastic raincoats and special "1997" umbrellas on the tarmac of Kai Tak international airport as steady rain fell.
Scores of school children waved flowers and small Chinese flags as Jiang and his party made their way along red carpets into waiting limousines.

At midnight (1600 GMT), Jiang will take back sovereignty over Hong Kong from Britain's Prince Charles in a ceremony that China regards as ending more than a century and a half of national humiliation at the hands of Western imperial powers.
Hong Kong was a mostly barren island when Britain seized it from a weak imperial China under an "unequal treaty" that ended the first Opium War in 1842.
